cases.key: runtime message-class construction (Class.new(const_get(...)) do + define_method + class_eval reopenings)
cases.mechanism: Entire message classes built inside Class.new blocks (message.rb:39) with interpolated define_method accessors and method_missing aliasing; well_known_types reopens the generated classes via class_eval; all inner defs/sends have no static class.

cases.key: attach_function FFI DSL + generated FFI singleton methods
cases.mechanism: class FFI extend ::FFI::Library + 125 attach_function declarations generate the entire native API surface (create_arena, get_field_by_number, ...); upb C library beneath (B).
cases.fix_direction: ffi plugin (rigor-ffi-plugin-author territory) interpreting attach_function signatures — names and arg/ret types are literal in the calls.

cases.key: FFI struct/union surface (MessageValue#[], by_value/by_ref, Pointer null?/read*)
cases.mechanism: ffi gem has no RBS; struct member access via layout metaprogramming.
The codebase idiom for crossing private-method boundaries; symbol is literal at virtually every site yet all sends answer Dynamic.
cases.fix_direction: Fold send/__send__/public_send with literal first arg into ordinary visibility-ignoring dispatch.

cases.mechanism: method(:literal) lookup and #call through an optional both decline.
cases.fix_direction: Type method(:literal) as Method with the target signature; dispatch #call through T?.
